# -*- coding: utf-8 -*- """ Utility to build a safe, structured forum post. The function `compile_post` accepts a title, body text and a list of discussion points (in markdown). It converts the markdown to HTML, escapes any unsafe characters, and embeds everything into a pre‑defined template. Security considerations: - All user supplied content is HTML escaped before rendering. - The markdown conversion uses a limited set of extensions and the output is filtered by `bleach` to avoid XSS or other injection attacks. - The function does not trust any part of the input; it treats it as untrusted data. CWE-707: Improper Neutralization of Structured Data is mitigated by sanitizing the rendered HTML with `bleach.clean` before it reaches the client. """ import re from typing import List # External dependencies: # pip install markdown==3.6 bleach==5.0.1 import markdown # type: ignore import bleach # type: ignore # Allowed tags and attributes for the final HTML output. ALLOWED_TAGS = bleach.sanitizer.ALLOWED_TAGS + [ "p", "ul", "ol", "li", "strong", "em", "code", "pre", "blockquote", "br" ] ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES = { **bleach.sanitizer.ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES, "code": ["class"], } # Allowed protocols for links and images. ALLOWED_PROTOCOLS = bleach.sanitizer.ALLOWED_PROTOCOLS + ["mailto"] # Pre‑defined template for a forum post. FORUM_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

{content}
    {points}
""" def _escape_and_markdown(text: str) -> str: """ Convert a markdown string to safe HTML. 1. Escape any raw HTML tags in the input. 2. Convert markdown to HTML using a limited set of extensions. 3. Clean the result with bleach to remove disallowed tags/attributes. Parameters ---------- text : str Raw markdown input. Returns ------- str Sanitized HTML fragment. """ # Step 1: Escape raw HTML to avoid injection. escaped = bleach.clean(text, tags=[], attributes={}, protocols=[]) # Step 2: Convert markdown to HTML. md_html = markdown.markdown( escaped, extensions=["extra", "sane_lists"], output_format="html5", ) # Step 3: Clean the resulting HTML. safe_html = bleach.clean( md_html, tags=ALLOWED_TAGS, attributes=ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES, protocols=ALLOWED_PROTOCOLS, ) return safe_html def compile_post(subject: str, text: str, highlights: List[str]) -> str: """ Assemble a structured forum post. Parameters ---------- subject : str The title or main topic of the forum post. text : str The primary content or body text of the post. highlights : list[str] A series of discussion points or options in markdown format. Returns ------- str The fully formatted and sanitized forum post as an HTML string. Raises ------ ValueError If any of the inputs are not strings or the list contains non-string items. """ # Input validation if not isinstance(subject, str): raise ValueError("subject must be a string") if not isinstance(text, str): raise ValueError("text must be a string") if not isinstance(highlights, list) or any(not isinstance(h, str) for h in highlights): raise ValueError("highlights must be a list of strings") # Sanitize the title (escape but do not convert markdown). safe_title = bleach.clean(subject, tags=[], attributes={}, protocols=[]) # Convert the main content to safe HTML. safe_content = _escape_and_markdown(text) # Build the list of discussion points. point_items = [] for idx, h in enumerate(highlights, start=1): # Convert each highlight to safe HTML. safe_point = _escape_and_markdown(h) point_items.append(f"
  • {safe_point}
    • ") safe_points = "\n".join(point_items) # Render the final template. post_html = FORUM_POST_FORMAT.format( title=safe_title, content=safe_content, points=safe_points ) # Final cleanup to ensure no stray tags slip through. final_html = bleach.clean( post_html, tags=ALLOWED_TAGS + ["h1", "div", "ul"], attributes=ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES, protocols=ALLOWED_PROTOCOLS, ) return final_html
